items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: KubeletInUserNamespace (aka Rootless mode) Graduates to Beta

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37: KubeletInUserNamespace (aka Rootless mode) Graduates to Beta.
sentences.zh: Kubernetes v 1.37 ： KubeletInUserNamespace （又名无根模式）毕业于Beta。

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes the KubeletInUserNamespace feature gate to beta.
sentences.zh: Kubernetes v 1.37将KubeletInUserNamespace功能提升为beta。

sentences.en: With this feature enabled, all of the node components (kubelet, CRI and OCI runtimes, CNI plugins, and kube-proxy) can run as a non-root user on the host, using a Linux user namespace .
sentences.zh: 启用此功能后，所有节点组件（ kubelet、CRI和OCI运行时、CNI插件和kube-proxy ）都可以使用Linux用户命名空间以非root用户身份在主机上运行。

sentences.en: This technique is also known as rootless mode .
sentences.zh: 这种技术也称为无根模式。

sentences.en: The work started as an experiment in 2018, and was merged into Kubernetes v1.22 (2021) as an alpha feature (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposal KEP-2033 ).
sentences.zh: 这项工作始于2018年的实验，并作为Alpha功能（ Kubernetes增强提案KEP-2033 ）合并到Kubernetes v 1.22 （ 2021 ）中。

sentences.en: This feature should not be confused with user namespaces for pods ( hostUsers: false with the UserNamespacesSupport feature gate, GA since v1.36), which puts pods in user namespaces but still runs the node components as root.
sentences.zh: 此功能不应与pod的用户命名空间混淆（ hostUsers ： false与UserNamespacesSupport功能门， GA自v 1.36起） ，后者将pod放在用户命名空间中，但仍以root身份运行节点组件。

sentences.en: These two features do not conflict.
sentences.zh: 这两个特点并不冲突。

sentences.en: Moreover, they can be combined to nest Kubernetes inside Kubernetes without resorting to the full privileged: true .
sentences.zh: 此外，它们可以组合在Kubernetes中嵌套Kubernetes ，而无需诉诸完全特权： true。

sentences.en: Why run the node components in a user namespace?
sentences.zh: 为什么要在用户命名空间中运行节点组件？

sentences.en: Because the node components have historically had container-breakout vulnerabilities that could compromise full root privileges on the host.
sentences.zh: 因为节点组件历来存在容器突破漏洞，可能危及主机上的完整根权限。

sentences.en: Examples of such vulnerabilities include: CVE-2022-0811 ("cr8escape"): CRI-O could be tricked into setting arbitrary sysctls, such as kernel.core_pattern , resulting in arbitrary code execution as root on the host CVE-2023-27561 : runc could be tricked into bypassing the masked paths of a container via a volume mount race, exposing the host's procfs files (a regression of CVE-2019-19921) CVE-2024-10220 : the kubelet could be made to execute arbitrary commands as root via gitRepo volumes ( gitRepo volumes had a similar vulnerability, CVE-2018-11235 , back in 2018 too) CVE-2025-31133 : runc could be tricked into bind-mounting attacker-controlled paths and writing to the host's procfs files, such as /proc/sysrq-trigger and /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern CVE-2026-53488 : containerd could be tricked into executing arbitrary commands on the host, via crafted labels in a container image By running the node components in a user namespace, the potential damage is confined to the non-root user's account.
sentences.zh: 此类漏洞的示例包括： CVE-2022-0811 （ “cr8escape” ） ： CRI-O可能被欺骗设置任意sysctl ，例如kernel.core_pattern ，导致在主机CVE-2023-27561上以root身份执行任意代码： runc可能被欺骗通过卷装载竞赛绕过容器的屏蔽路径，暴露主机的procfs文件（ CVE-2019-19921的回归） CVE-2024-10220 ： kubelet可能通过gitRepo卷以root身份执行任意命令（ gitRep

sentences.en: Notably, an attacker cannot conceal their intrusion by modifying the kernel, the boot loader, or the firmware.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，攻击者无法通过修改内核、引导加载程序或固件来隐藏其入侵。

items.title: UN votes to adopt new world map that shows Africa’s true scale

sentences.en: UN votes to adopt new world map that shows Africa’s true scale.
sentences.zh: 联合国投票通过新的世界地图，展示非洲的真实规模。

sentences.en: Togo-sponsored resolution called to phase out traditional map that depicts continent as similar size to Greenland The United Nations has voted to adopt a resolution for the world to formally phase out the traditional Mercator map of the globe in favour of one that more accurately displays Africa’s size.
sentences.zh: 多哥赞助的决议呼吁逐步淘汰将大陆描绘成与格陵兰岛大小相似的传统地图联合国投票通过了一项决议，要求世界正式逐步淘汰传统的墨卡托全球地图，转而采用更准确地显示非洲大小的地图。

sentences.en: In a session at its headquarters in New York, the UN general assembly officially retired the 16th-century Mercator projection in favour of one based on the more accurate 2018 Equal Earth design.
sentences.zh: 在纽约总部举行的一次会议上，联合国大会正式淘汰了16世纪的墨卡托预测，转而采用基于更准确的2018年平等地球设计的预测。

items.title: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration

sentences.en: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration.
sentences.zh: HydraFusion项目：通过多模型编排实现前沿品质。

sentences.en: Providing developers the best model for the task at hand has always been our goal.
sentences.zh: 为开发人员提供手头任务的最佳模型一直是我们的目标。

sentences.en: Earlier this year, we made that easier by launching Auto model selection, which reviews your task and matches it to the best-suited model for that task.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，我们推出了自动模型选择功能，该功能会审核您的任务，并将其与最适合该任务的模型进行匹配。

sentences.en: Today, we re introducing Project HydraFusion, a research preview that delivers frontier intelligence through runtime orchestration.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将推出HydraFusion项目，这是一个通过运行时编排提供前沿智能的研究预览。

sentences.en: It creates a full execution plan, choosing from models across multiple providers to draft, critique and revise, or cascade to more powerful models to complete your task.
sentences.zh: 它创建了一个完整的执行计划，从多个提供商的模型中进行选择，以起草、批评和修改，或级联到更强大的模型来完成您的任务。

sentences.en: HydraFusion fills a key role in our overall strategy to deliver automated semantic routing between local, cloud, and compound models.
sentences.zh: HydraFusion在我们的整体战略中发挥着关键作用，在本地、云和复合模型之间提供自动语义路由。

sentences.en: For developers, that complexity stays behind the scenes: you select HydraFusion like any other model, and it chooses a workflow that balances performance, cost, and latency for each task.
sentences.zh: 对于开发人员来说，这种复杂性隐藏在幕后：您像选择任何其他模型一样选择HydraFusion ，它会选择一个平衡每个任务的性能、成本和延迟的工作流。

sentences.en: Now available as a research preview HydraFusion is available to users on all GitHub Copilot plans through /experimental in GitHub Copilot CLI .
sentences.zh: HydraFusion现已作为研究预览版提供给所有GitHub Copilot计划的用户，通过/在GitHub Copilot CLI中进行实验。

sentences.en: Usage is based on the tokens consumed by the models HydraFusion uses, priced at each model s standard rate .
sentences.zh: 使用量基于HydraFusion使用的型号使用的代币，按每个型号的标准费率定价。

sentences.en: To try HydraFusion in Copilot CLI: Run /update to install the latest version Run /experimental on Run /model , then select HydraFusion (Research Preview) Please post feedback in the GitHub Community .
sentences.zh: 要在Copilot CLI中尝试HydraFusion ：运行/更新以安装最新版本在Run/model上运行/experimental ，然后选择HydraFusion （研究预览）请在GitHub社区中发布反馈。

sentences.en: HydraFusion treats workflow selection as an optimization problem.
sentences.zh: HydraFusion将工作流程选择视为一个优化问题。

sentences.en: It uses capability signals for reasoning, code generation, debugging, and tool use to select the most efficient execution pattern to meet the quality bar.
sentences.zh: 它使用功能信号进行推理、代码生成、调试和工具使用，以选择最有效的执行模式来满足质量标准。
